The jump from the previous 182 to 299 was ladder0's control arm landing 2026-08-12, not drift.

wb_class_use.note:
Collapsed with the Wb*->Om* engine rename. What remains is the public controller ABI (WbNodeRef, WbDeviceTag, ...), which must never be renamed, plus the web viewer's independent JS class tree.
  Re-snapshotted 2026-08-16 (verification lane) 6088 -> 6090. The +2 is NOT code: it is AGENTS.md and CHANGELOG.md prose spelling WbDeviceTag / WbNodeRef / WbFieldRef while explaining that the C ABI deliberately did NOT move. Verified by diffing the working tree: 3 added lines carry the pattern, all in those two documents, and zero source files gained one. A doc that describes the rename must name the symbols it did not rename; this ratchet counts that prose, so the category can only be held by re-snapshotting it.

webots_home_env.note:
Grew intentionally: the runtime env contract moved to OMNISIM_* with WEBOTS_* kept as a working fallback, so every reader now names both. Re-snapshotted 2026-08-16: 336 -> 318. The -20 is the launcher rename (webots_controller.c carried 23 WEBOTS_HOME reads; omnisim_controller.c carries 2, keeping only the documented legacy fallback), offset by +3 in src/python/omniworld/validation/headless.py which now names both vars. NOTE the audit counts untracked-but-not-ignored files too, so this 318 is the staged number: measured mid-migration with the renamed-to file still untracked it read 316, and a baseline taken then would have flipped this ratchet red the moment the rename was staged.
  Re-snapshotted 2026-08-16 (verification lane) 318 -> 320. Same self-referential cause: 8 added and 2 removed lines mention WEBOTS_HOME, every one of them AGENTS.md/CHANGELOG.md prose documenting that the runtime contract moved to OMNISIM_* and that WEBOTS_HOME still works at BUILD time. No source file gained a read.
